title: nsoRewards
description: This is a reward plugin that allows players to earn economy (Vault) through certain actions while playing, along with a check-in feature and a red packet feature (very cool!). All features can be freely toggled on or off.
body:
# nsoRewards

A lightweight Bukkit rewards plugin with daily sign-in, hongbao, online rewards, mining rewards, kill rewards, death penalties, and storage box support.

## Features

- Daily sign-in with money, points, and item rewards
- Hongbao system with normal, password, and luck-based modes
- BookUI and Paper Dialog UI support
- Mining, kill, and online rewards
- Death penalty with random or percentage deduction
- Storage box for overflow items
- World blacklist / whitelist support
- Player sound toggle support

## Requirements

- **Java**: 8+
- **Server**: Spigot/Paper 1.20 - 26.1
- **Required**: [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)
- **Optional**: [PlayerPoints](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/playerpoints.80745/), [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/), ViaVersion

> Dialog UI requires **Paper 1.21.7+**.

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/nsr signin` | Open the sign-in UI | `nsorewards.signin` |
| `/nsr signin click <player>` | Sign in for a player | `nsorewards.admin` |
| `/nsr signin top` | View the sign-in leaderboard | - |
| `/nsr storage` | Open the storage box | - |
| `/hongbao` | Open the hongbao UI | - |
| `/nsr sound-toggle` | Toggle sound effects | - |
| `/nsr reload` | Reload config files | `nsorewards.reload` |
| `/nsr help` | Show help | - |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `nsorewards.signin` | Sign-in permission |
| `nsorewards.admin` | Admin permission |
| `nsorewards.reload` | Reload permission |

## Config Files

- `config.yml` — Main plugin config
- `messages.yml` — Message config
- `gui/signin.yml` — Sign-in BookUI
- `gui/signin_dialog.yml` — Sign-in Dialog UI
- `gui/hongbao.yml` — Hongbao BookUI
- `gui/hongbao_dialog.yml` — Hongbao Dialog UI

Missing fields are automatically filled from defaults inside the JAR.

## Placeholders

- `%nsorewards_is_signed%`
- `%nsorewards_signed_streak%`
- `%nsorewards_hongbao_count%`
